items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: We had Clarence Hutchenrider from the Casa Loma band, and Jimmy Maxwell who played with Benny Goodman, Bernie Privin who was with Artie Shaw, Carmen Mastren who played guitar with Tommy Dorsey.

ctx.x: And that evolved into a group that you could gig with?

Yeah. A lot of times, the older fellows, they didn’t want to travel. We had Clarence Hutchenrider from the Casa Loma band, and Jimmy Maxwell who played with Benny Goodman, Bernie Privin who was with Artie Shaw, Carmen Mastren who played guitar with Tommy Dorsey. And they — Dill Jones, who wasn’t as old as those fellows but still a veteran, on great piano. And many, many musicians, Bobby Prane, we had Herbie “Cat” Collins, a great drummer from the 1930s who played with a lot of the black bands, and there was a…
You know Al is still playing?
